subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: She works as ___ at the new plant.
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound and is a first mention, so the indefinite article is an.
questions.explanation_ar: engineer تبدأ بصوت متحرك وهي أول ذكر، فالأداة النكرة هي an.

questions.question: The report ___ by the team yesterday.
questions.explanation: A finished past action with an agent takes the past simple passive was written by.
questions.explanation_ar: الفعل الماضي المنتهي مع ذكر الفاعل يأخذ المبني للمجهول was written by.

questions.question: I ___ in Wasit since 2019 and I am still here.
questions.explanation: Since with a continuing situation requires the present perfect.
questions.explanation_ar: since مع حالة مستمرة تتطلب المضارع التام.

questions.question: When we arrived, the film ___.
questions.explanation: The past perfect shows the film started before we arrived.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام يدل على أن الفيلم بدأ قبل وصولنا.

questions.question: We ___ at eight tomorrow; the room is booked.
questions.explanation: A confirmed future arrangement takes the present continuous with a time expression.
questions.explanation_ar: الترتيب المستقبلي المؤكد يأخذ المضارع المستمر مع ظرف زمني.

questions.question: Complete: '___ buyers are looking at houses.' Which choice, and why?
options: an, it starts with a vowel
a, it is a first mention here
options_en: an, it starts with a vowel
a, it is a first mention here
questions.explanation: Buyers and houses are general plurals here, so neither takes an article.
questions.explanation_ar: buyers و houses جمع عام هنا، فلا يأخذ أياً منهما أداة.

questions.question: Complete: 'I have ___ big news.' Which choice, and why?
options: the, the news was named before
an, news starts with a vowel
a, news is a countable singular
options_en: the, the news was named before
an, news starts with a vowel
a, news is a countable singular
questions.explanation: News is uncountable, so it takes no article in a general statement.
questions.explanation_ar: news اسم غير معدود، فلا يأخذ أداة في الجملة العامة.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the present continuous for a temporary situation?
options: I stay with my aunt at the moment now.
I stayed with my aunt at the moment.
I'll stay with my aunt at the moment.
I'm staying with my aunt at the moment.
options_en: I stay with my aunt at the moment now.
I stayed with my aunt at the moment.
I'll stay with my aunt at the moment.
I'm staying with my aunt at the moment.
questions.explanation: The continuous marks a situation limited to one particular week, not a permanent arrangement.
questions.explanation_ar: الصيغة المستمرة تدل على حالة محدودة بفترة معينة لا على ترتيب دائم.
